assessments.reasoning: The Index's SCOPE.md at commit cdff8aeed68bf1f9c62d8c86159c7dc08b2d75d7 includes relevant data terms. Its admission table at bytes [533,942) requires an identifiable grant or licence, edition and controlling source. ODbL §3.1 supplies the grant and the publisher heading supplies the edition. The taxonomy establishes the kind criterion only.

The four contiguous captures from https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/ cover bytes [0,51543) and report the same full SHA-256, 85bc21fb2c00b2effb9202b2aa785934ce5a05df954e17cbd2a1f7c10c04c633. The publisher heading names ODbL v1.0. The preamble and §§2.1–3.1 identify applicable copyright, database rights, contractual terms and a conditional database-use grant. All four parts witness one publisher representation.

The Index decision of 2026-11-26 at commit afb962e68831a16accb80c70159b1e2f1fbb4dbc, bytes [3316,3526), lists permanent entity `8bec8dc2880b43338021b178efd7cd20`, the opaque ID in subject `e-8bec8dc2880b43338021b178efd7cd20`. The same row gives `Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0`, `odbl-1-0`, `sha256:85bc21fb2c00b2effb9202b2aa785934ce5a05df954e17cbd2a1f7c10c04c633`, `license` and `active`. The decision expressly limits its authority to Index maintenance.

limitations: The publisher evidence supports the data branch of the claim. Application to a particular public-sector database requires evidence that its licensor offered it under ODbL. Sections 2.3–2.4 exclude database software and distinguish rights in the database from rights in individual contents.

`active` means the Index maintains the reference for current lookup. Publisher currency, SPDX deprecation, work-specific grants, redistribution rights and installation eligibility each require separate evidence.
This fresh research assessment supports source verification only. Independent review and consumer release authorization are separate decisions.
